$description: GENERATED from Figma variables. Do not edit by hand: re-export from Figma (scripts/tokens/figma-pull.mjs or the plugin export) and regenerate.

default.$description: Brand primary fill: primary buttons, checkbox, key highlights.
Brand secondary fill (Sky): secondary highlights and badges.

subtle.$description: Soft brand surface for large areas: promo banners, Sky header bars, quotes, covers.

default.$description: Default surface: cards, panels, modals, popovers.
Brand accent fill (gold): accent buttons and highlights.
Interactive fill (Active blue): selected and active states of controls.
Neutral component fill at rest: chips, tags, segmented controls, progress tracks.

subtle.$description: Lowest-emphasis neutral fill: section backgrounds, skeletons, quiet panels.

bold.$description: Highest-emphasis neutral fill (charcoal in Light): dark badges and bars.

default.$description: Fill of disabled controls.

bold.$description: Stronger disabled fill for selected-but-disabled states (checked checkbox, switch on).

default.$description: Solid critical fill: destructive buttons, error badges.

subtle.$description: Soft error background: error alerts and banners (used by Alert).

default.$description: Solid success fill: success badges and indicators.

subtle.$description: Soft success background: success alerts and banners (used by Alert).

default.$description: Solid warning fill: warning badges and indicators.

subtle.$description: Soft warning background: warning alerts and banners (used by Alert).

default.$description: Solid info fill: info badges and indicators.

subtle.$description: Soft info background: info alerts and banners (used by Alert).

stripe.$description: Alternating row stripe for zebra tables.

default.$description: Transparent fill for ghost and tertiary controls at rest.

hover.$description: Ghost or tertiary control on hover.

pressed.$description: Ghost or tertiary control while pressed.

disabled.$description: Fill of a disabled form field.

default.$description: Fill of form fields and controls: input, dropdown, checkbox, radio, chat compose.

page.$description: Page canvas behind all content, on marketing and application pages.

brand.$description: GLOBAL HEADER, UTILITY BAR AND FOOTER ONLY (follows the page theme).

default.$description: Avatar fill (initials avatars).

selected.$description: Selected state for rows, list items and cards.

hover.$description: Hover surface for rows and list items.

accent.$description: Accent page section (marketing bands, hero panels, CTA bands).

default.$description: COMPONENT TEXT — labels and UI text inside components (buttons, inputs, tables).

hover.$description: Brand-colour text or icon on hover.

pressed.$description: Brand-colour text or icon while pressed.

default.$description: COMPONENT TEXT — UI text inside components.

subtler.$description: Lowest-emphasis readable text: helper text, timestamps.

on-primary.$description: Text and icons on the primary fill: Sky on Midnight in light, Midnight on Sky in Inverse (14.72:1 both).

default.$description: Hyperlink text and icons.
Info text and icons: info messages and info alert content.
Error text and icons: validation messages and critical alert content.

hover.$description: Critical text or icon on hover.

pressed.$description: Critical text or icon while pressed.

default.$description: Success text and icons: confirmation messages and success alert content.
Warning text and icons: warning messages and warning alert content.

on-media.$description: Text and icons on images and video: video controls, time labels, labels on the media overlay.

placeholder.$description: Placeholder text inside a form field.

default.$description: Entered text and icons inside a form field.

on-secondary.$description: Text and icons on the secondary (Sky) fill.

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on the accent (gold) fill.

on-critical.$description: Text and icons on the solid critical fill.

on-success.$description: Text and icons on the solid success fill.

on-warning.$description: Text and icons on the solid warning fill.

on-neutral.$description: Text and icons on the bold neutral (charcoal) fill.

on-info.$description: Text and icons on the solid info fill.

on-brand.$description: GLOBAL HEADER, UTILITY BAR AND FOOTER ONLY.

disabled.$description: Text and icons in disabled controls.

default.$description: CONTENT TEXT — paragraphs.

on-shell.$description: Paragraph / body copy on shell and brand bands (background/shell).

default.$description: CONTENT TEXT — headings and display text.
Translucent default border for use on images or tinted fills.

subtle.$description: Translucent subtle border for use on images or tinted fills.

default.$description: Default component border: outlined controls at rest, cards and dividers that need presence.
Brand border: secondary buttons, selected cards.
Interactive border (Active blue): selected and active controls.
Gold border for accent elements.
Form field border at rest.

hover.$description: Form field border on hover and while typing.

default.$description: Info border: info alerts and cards.
Error border: invalid fields, error alerts and cards.
Success border: success alerts and cards.
Warning border: warning alerts and cards.
Focus ring for keyboard focus.

hover.$description: State layer on hover over neutral surfaces (list rows, ghost buttons).

pressed.$description: State layer while pressed over neutral surfaces.

hover.$description: Active-blue state layer on hover over interactive items.

brand.$description: Strong Midnight-tinted layer over brand imagery (hero images).
